name: USD Somnia
oneLiner: Frax-issued USDso wraps frxUSD on Somnia, with on-chain parent-token redemption and administrator-controlled issuance and custody.
collateral: Somnia frxUSD held by the local BrandedCustodian; Treasury funds and other cash-equivalent reserves sit upstream in frxUSD.
pegMechanism: The BrandedCustodian burns caller-owned USDso and returns frxUSD. At the pin, custodianTkn() was Somnia frxUSD 0x00000000d61733e7a393a10a5b48c311abe8f1e5; totalAssets(), brandedCoinMinted(), actual frxUSD custody and child supply matched. previewRedeem(1e18)=1e18, redeemFee()=0 and isolatedBackingEnabled()=false. The terms identify Frax Inc. and/or affiliates as issuer, disclaim Somnia fiat-redemption responsibility and exclude a holder yield entitlement.

proofOfReserves.provider: On-chain parent-token custody; not independent financial assurance
